_comment: Sim v2.1 frozen sensitivity configurations (R-20261017-001). One-at-a-time variants of the Sim v2 defaults. Every value is provisional: ranges come from paper/notes/load_metrics_literature.md (section in 'source') or, where the literature gives none, from the design's provisional +-50% rule (marked PROVISIONAL). Do not edit after the W0 v2.1 spec is approved. Agents train on 'default'; the other configs are evaluation only.

source.theta: council C-20261016-01 card: sensitivity at 0.8 and 0.9; capacity at 30 pods is extrapolated
council C-20261016-01 card: sensitivity at 0.8 and 0.9

source.rebalance_steps: load_metrics_literature.md 4.2 (redisblog2026asm, vendor grade B): legacy migration 192-219 s at 5 GB = about 13-15 control steps of 15 s; 14 is the midpoint. Dataset size on our cluster unknown, so PROVISIONAL

source.rebalance_loss: PROVISIONAL: default 0.3 x 0.5 (design +-50%); literature gives no capacity-loss figure (4.2, 4.3)
PROVISIONAL: default 0.3 x 1.5 (design +-50%); literature gives no capacity-loss figure (4.2, 4.3)

load_metrics_literature.md 4.2 (redisblog2026asm): ASM average latency rose under 5 % for 2 s, throughput at baseline; used as a PROVISIONAL proxy for the capacity loss (capacity effect not reported), k stays 1 (6-9 s < one step)

source.latency_add_s: load_metrics_literature.md 1.4 (redisdocs_latency): typical network latency 200 us on 1 Gbit/s TCP; flagged provisional for our cluster

source.tail_scale: PROVISIONAL: design +50% (kappa >= 1); li2014tales only says real tails are worse than queueing models, no number (1.1)

source.cpu_offset_pct: PROVISIONAL: literature gives no range (2.3: fork stalls and background CPU do not follow request rate; no percentage). Observation only
PROVISIONAL: as cpu_offset_10, twice the offset. Observation only
